{"action":"edit","path":"toolformer_filter.py","old_text":"","new_text":"import numpy as np

def filter_api_calls(with_result, call_only, no_call, tau_filter):
    # Input validation
    if not isinstance(with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("All inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if with_result.ndim != 2 or call_only.ndim != 2 or no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("All inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if with_result.shape != call_only.shape or with_result.shape != no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("Shape mismatch between inputs")
    if with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Empty input array")
    if np.any(np.isnan(with_result)) or np.any(np.isinf(with_result)) or \
       np.any(np.isnan(call_only)) or np.any(np.isinf(call_only)) or \
       np.any(np.isnan(no_call)) or np.any(np.isinf(no_call)):
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite values in input")
    if np.any(with_result > 0) or np.any(call_only > 0) or np.any(no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("Positive log probabilities detected")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric non-boolean scalar")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    
    n_candidates, future_horizon = with_result.shape
    
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)
    
    # Weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log probability)
    L_plus = -np.sum(norm_weights * with_result, axis=1)
    L_call = -np.sum(norm_weights * call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(norm_weights * no_call, axis=1)
    
    # Counterfactual baseline (min of empty and call-only)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call)
    
    # Margin and keep decision
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    
    return keep, margins
